Scattered across the many diversities of the
new found land Humans wandered and made
places for themselves among all others. Able
to resist all the elements and magics, and
learned in the ways of the mystical arts,
they were well equipped to settle where they
wished. Soon they thrived across the land
and with the others began to tame the beasts
and cultivate the fields.

In the forests and valleys settled spry creatures
of great intelligence. Thin and strong, the
Elves were quite at home among the trees and
fields of green.
Though weaker in endurance than some, they
were possessed of a high aptitude for the
magical arts and resistance to it.

In the snowy areas of bitter cold found the
 Gnomes their home. Like the Elves, they
 were strong of mind, not body, and a little
less prone to the ways of magic. But unlike
 the brooding Elf, the Gnome was very jolly
and quick to make friends. Because of
the harshness of the snowy land
 their countenance was toughened to the elements,
 and even more so to magic.

Sojourned then in the desert sun the Dwarf.
 Small but mighty they survived in the
 turmoil of the stormy war for little of the
elemental realm could do them great harm.
After all, it would take a strong creature
 to find a thriving life in the lands of sand.
 With little power over magic, Dwarves found
their strength in solitude among the dunes.

And in the swamps and bogs settled a tribal
 people of great strength and endurance.
 So strong were they that fire, acid and cold
 could hardly harm them. Because they lacked
the greatness of mind for magic they had to rely
on their ability to fight to survive, and that
ability was developed to great heights,
 for the Orcs lived for battle and saw the
opposing of men as the greatest of endeavors.
To become a Knight, one must be strong. With high endurance and the best melee skills, they are born fighters.
Strength, endurance paired with a great personality makes a Paladin. While primarily a fighter, their knowledge in clerical spells can save lives.
The highly intelligent wizards, are rather frail and weak fighters. Their strength lies in their knowledge of the arcane magical arts.
To be a successful thief, you must be accurate and lucky. While being a decent fighter, nobody beats you at picking locks.
It is pure endurance, which makes it almost impossible to defeat a Barbarian. Paired with good melee skills the are excellent fighters.
Accuracy and intelligence describes the qualities of an archer best. Besides the unmatched ranged abilities, an Archer also has some arcane magical power.
The high personality of the Cleric makes him highly empathic. While not much of a fighter, his clerical spells are a major support in any battle.
Fast and precise are the Ninja's qualities. While more fragile than other fighters, they master ranged and melee combat and are evasive.
When intelligence meets a great personality, you are probably looking at a Druid. Masters of nature magic, they can shape the world around them.
Intelligence, personality, endurance and speed makes Rangers versatile fighters and skilled in both melee and ranged combat combined with the power of nature magic
